old.text: The largest of the named DO Empordà growers, around two hundred hectares, organic for over twenty years and focused on native varieties — now led by Anna Espelt, with a modern winery beside the family farmhouse and a second estate, Mas Marès, above Cala Montjoi.

old.name: Celler Mas Estela
old.hook: Selva de Mar (Cap de Creus) — biodynamic since 1999
old.text: Sixteen hectares of estate fruit farmed biodynamically since 1999 to lunar and planetary cycles — Grenache, Muscat, Syrah and Samsó, hand-harvested. The cult names are Vinya Selva de Mar and Quindals, plus the sweet Moscatell Estela.

old_also.name: Mas Estela — biodynamic
old_also.hook: Sixteen hectares at Selva de Mar, biodynamic since 1999.
old_also.text: Organic from 1989 and biodynamic since 1999, hand-harvested estate fruit farmed to lunar and planetary cycles with no synthetic inputs — Grenache (noir and gris), Muscat, Syrah and Samsó. The cult names are Vinya Selva de Mar (red and white) and Quindals. The Cap de Creus terroir in a glass.

old.hook: Cadaqués — 300 m inside the Cap de Creus park
old.text: A family winery of about eleven hectares on the Cadaqués pass at three hundred metres, surrounded by the sea inside the natural park — Picapoll, Muscat and Grenache under the Cadaqués brand.

old_also.name: Martín Faixó — Cadaqués

old_also.text: About eleven hectares at three hundred metres on the Cadaqués pass, "surrounded by the sea" inside the natural park — Picapoll, Muscat and Grenache under the Cadaqués brand. The dramatic coastal-mountain setting, schist underfoot and tramuntana overhead, is the signature.
